assets.name: acanthus-double-medallion-with-two-winged-figures
assets.description: Two winged putti seated among clouds inside connected circular medallions with acanthus tendrils, from Lucas van Leyden’s 1517 engraving. Part of the Two Putti acanthus medallions set.

provenance.title: Two Putti Seated in Clouds in Circles with Tendrils

extraction.method: A single SIFT/RANSAC similarity transform registers extracted AI alpha to the original scan. AI alpha supplies ownership only; original source RGB is never warped, resized, strengthened or redrawn. Native continuous closed-form edge matting and foreground decontamination are solved in overlapping bounded tiles; exact original RGB is retained at opaque pixels. Original/white/dark visual review is required; alpha ownership remains approximate.

extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the referenced ORIGINAL historic engraving for a museum decorative-art collection. Produce a transparent cutout of this exact existing ornament, with all source proportions and engraved detail preserved. Subject: The entire original connected pair of circular foliate roundels, both winged children on their actual clouds, their small props and all surrounding foliate scrolls. Remove the letter L between the circles and the background hatch. Keep the engraved cloudy supports as intrinsic scene props, but clear true open space inside and around both roundels. Do not invent a repeat. Remove the dense straight crosshatched BACKGROUND field, page paper, outer plate rules, unrelated signatures, date panels and cartouche lettering. Clear every genuine opening between leaves, limbs, wings, stems and scrolls. Foreground curved hatching, original ink texture, pale illustrated surfaces and every real contour stay intact and opaque. Keep every original finger, toe, curl, narrow connecting line, leaf tooth and motif tip. Keep physically contacting figures and shared props together. Do not invent missing source-truncated ends or extend motifs beyond the original. Do not add shading, symmetry, anatomy, detail or generic replacement foliage. Do not redesign, simplify, beautify, sharpen into modern line art, stretch or compress the original height-to-width ratio. Preserve the exact original long narrow arrangement when present. Use fine antialiased edges without paper halos or stepped polygon cuts. Genuine transparent alpha outside and inside the openings; no white rectangle, checkerboard paint, background hatching or shadow.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Full native source, white/dark and detail review confirms both original contacting roundels, complete acanthus curls, source clouds/figures/held props and all native opaque flesh, leaves and cloud shading. Corrected alpha removes print-ground fringe and ray background inside the circles; old native version with filled sky is superseded. Source geometry is registered with 55 inliers and 2.43-native-pixel RMS; original source RGB unscaled. The lower decorative network remains connected. Exact AI ownership prompt and actual guide retained; no new repeat or SVG.

assets.usage_notes: Complete finite original foliate double roundel with both winged children, held props and original contacting cloud supports. assets.name: winged-child-with-cross-on-clouds
assets.description: A robed winged child with a thin cross, seated on original clouds. Part of the Two Putti acanthus medallions set.

provenance.title: Two Putti Seated in Clouds in Circles with Tendrils

extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. ONLY the RIGHT original robed winged child seated on the complete original cloud support, with the thin cross shaft and its whole cross head. Keep the original pointing arm, other hand, folded drapery, visible bare toes, both source-visible wings and the complete original cloud silhouettes. Exclude the outer circular ring, all decorative border scrolls and diagonal background hatch. No invented hidden feathers, shortened shaft or new clouds. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.
extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected visible original subject bounds, excluding ROI whitespace and neighbouring entities.

review.notes: Compared original region with white/dark alpha renders. Original garment/cloud foot, cross, both lobed leaf clusters and ivy tips retained; actual openings clear and pale/gold painted foreground opaque. No letter forms delivered.
